name: Marina Beach
description: The second longest urban beach in the world, stretching over 13 km along the Coromandel Coast of the Bay of Bengal. Famous for evening lighthouse panoramas, street food crisps, and sea breeze walks.
address: Marina Beach Road, Triplicane, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600005
best_time_to_visit: Early morning (5:30 AM - 7:30 AM) or Evening (5:00 PM - 8:30 PM)

name: Kapaleeshwarar Temple, Mylapore
description: A 7th-century historic Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, renowned for its towering 37-meter gopuram, stucco mythological sculptures, and massive sacred temple tank in Mylapore cultural hub.
address: 12, Vadannadha St, Mylapore, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600004
best_time_to_visit: Morning (6:30 AM - 11:30 AM) or Evening (5:00 PM - 8:30 PM)
dress_code_advisory: Traditional or modest temple attire required. Footwear deposited outside.

name: San Thome Cathedral Basilica
description: A rare 16th-century Portuguese Neo-Gothic cathedral built over the historic tomb of Saint Thomas, one of the twelve apostles of Jesus Christ. Features pristine white spires and a museum.
highlights: One of only three apostolic basilicas worldwide
address: 38, San Thome High Rd, Dummingkuppam, Mylapore, Chennai 600004
best_time_to_visit: Morning (8:00 AM - 12:00 PM) or Late Afternoon (4:00 PM - 6:00 PM)

name: Fort St. George & Clive House
sub_category: First British Fortress & Museum in India
description: Founded in 1644 by the British East India Company, Fort St. George was the nucleus around which modern Chennai grew. Houses St. Mary's Church (oldest Anglican church in India) and Fort Museum.
address: Rajaji Salai, Near Secretariat, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600009

name: Guindy National Park & Children's Park
description: One of the very few national parks situated entirely inside an Indian city. Home to spotted deer, blackbucks, over 130 bird species, lush tropical dry evergreen forest canopy, and nature trails.
best_time_to_visit: Morning (9:00 AM - 11:30 AM) or Afternoon (3:30 PM - 5:30 PM)

name: Edward Elliot's Beach (Bessie Beach)
description: A tranquil beach located in Besant Nagar. Known for the iconic Karl Schmidt Memorial, clean sandy walkways, open sea breeze, and vibrant surrounding cafes and gelato parlors.
address: 6th Ave, Besant Nagar, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600090
best_time_to_visit: Late afternoon or Evening (4:30 PM - 8:30 PM)
